lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee satigur poore kee jis kirapaal hovai tis ridai vasehaa ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Perfect True Guru's Bani is Ambrosial Nectar; it dwells in the heart of one who is blessed by the Guru's Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਹਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa tis kaa kateeai sadaa sadaa sukh hohaa ||2||
lines.translation: His coming and going in reincarnation is ended; forever and ever, he is at peace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਬੁਝਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaanaa ja(n)t so tudh bujhaee ||
lines.translation: He alone understands You, Lord, with whom You are pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaanaa ja(n)t s daragah sijhaee ||
lines.translation: He alone is approved in the Court of the Lord, with whom You are pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no teree nadar haumai tis gaee ||
lines.translation: Egotism is eradicated, when You bestow Your Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਕਲਮਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਖਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no too sa(n)tusat kalamal tis khaee ||
lines.translation: Sins are erased, when You are thoroughly pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਲਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੋ ਭਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kai suaamee val nirabhau so bhaee ||
lines.translation: One who has the Lord Master on his side, becomes fearless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਥਿਅਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no too kirapaal sachaa so thiaee ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with Your Mercy, becomes truthful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਇਆ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no teree maiaa na pohai aganaee ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with Your Kindness, is not touched by fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tis no sadaa daiaal jin gur te mat laee ||7||
lines.translation: You are forever Merciful to those who are receptive to the Guru's Teachings. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa kirapaal aape bakhas lai ||
lines.translation: Please grant Your Grace, O Merciful Lord; please forgive me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਇ ਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa japee teraa naam satigur paai pai ||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, I chant Your Name; I fall at the feet of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੁ ਦੂਖਾ ਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan a(n)tar vas dookhaa naas hoi ||
lines.translation: Please, dwell within my mind and body, and end my sufferings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਥ ਦੇਇ ਆਪਿ ਰਖੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਭਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hath dei aap rakh viaapai bhau na koi ||
lines.translation: Please give me Your hand, and save me, that fear may not afflict me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਏਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavaa din rain etai ka(n)m laai ||
lines.translation: May I sing Your Glorious Praises day and night; please commit me to this task.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kai sa(n)g haumai rog jaai ||
lines.translation: Associating with the humble Saints, the disease of egotism is eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar khasam eko rav rahiaa ||
lines.translation: The One Lord and Master is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee sach sacho sach lahiaa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have truly found the Truest of the True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa karahu daiaal apanee siphat dehu ||
lines.translation: Please bless me with Your Kindness, O Kind Lord, and bless me with Your Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਏਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: darasan dekh nihaal naanak preet eh ||1||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I am in ecstasy; this is what Nanak loves. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਇਕਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko japeeai manai maahi ikas kee saranaai ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the One Lord within your mind, and enter the Sanctuary of the One Lord alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikas siu kar pirahaRee doojee naahee jaai ||
lines.translation: Be in love with the One Lord; there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: iko daataa ma(n)geeai sabh kichh palai paai ||
lines.translation: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you will be blessed with everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan saas giraas prabh iko ik dhiaai ||
lines.translation: In your mind and body, with each breath and morsel of food, meditate on the One and only Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan sach guramukh paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the true treasure, the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee te sa(n)t jan jin man vuthaa aai ||
lines.translation: Very fortunate are those humble Saints, within whose minds the Lord has come to abide.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa doojaa koee naahi ||
lines.translation: He is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhiaaee naam ucharaa naanak khasam rajaai ||2||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Naam, and chanting the Naam, Nanak abides in the Will of his Lord and Master. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no too rakhavaalaa maare tis kaun ||
lines.translation: One who has You as his Saving Grace - who can kill him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਜਿਤਾ ਤਿਨੈ ਭੈਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no too rakhavaalaa jitaa tinai bhain ||
lines.translation: One who has You as his Saving Grace conquers the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no teraa a(n)g tis mukh ujalaa ||
lines.translation: One who has You on his side - his face is radiant and bright.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no teraa a(n)g s niramalee hoo(n) niramalaa ||
lines.translation: One who has You on his side, is the purest of the Pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੁਛੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no teree nadar na lekhaa puchheeai ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with Your Grace is not called to give his account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਖੁਸੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਭੁੰਚੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no teree khusee tin nau nidh bhu(n)cheeai ||
lines.translation: One with whom You are pleased, obtains the nine treasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਛੰਦਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no too prabh val tis kiaa muhachha(n)dagee ||
lines.translation: One who has You on his side, God - unto whom is he subservient?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੰਦਿਗੀ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jis no teree mihar s teree ba(n)digee ||8||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with Your Kind Mercy is dedicated to Your worship. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hohu kripaal suaamee mere sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)g vihaave ||
lines.translation: Be Merciful, O my Lord and Master, that I may pass my life in the Society of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਸਿ ਜਮਿ ਜਮਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੁਕਨਿ ਹਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tudhahu bhule s jam jam marade tin kade na chukan haave ||1||
lines.translation: Those who forget You are born only to die and be reincarnated again; their sufferings will never end. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਘਟ ਘਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur simarahu aapanaa ghat avaghat ghat ghaat ||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance within your heart on the True Guru, whether you are on the most difficult path, on the mountain or by the river bank.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਤਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੰਧੈ ਵਾਟ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japa(n)tiaa koi na ba(n)dhai vaat ||2||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, no one shall block your way. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:
